verdict.rationale: PostHog exposes SQL/HogQL and API access that could enable operating on many rows/events at once (posthog-docs-8, posthog-docs-17, posthog-docs-11), and its CLI/MCP integration lets agents run queries or automation via terminal/CI (posthog-docs-20, posthog-docs-24), but there is no explicit documentation of true bulk operations (e.g., batch update/delete across many feature flags, insights, or dashboards) as a single action for an AI agent. missing for 10: explicit bulk-edit/batch-update API or UI examples, evidence of an agent performing multi-item operations in one call, independent confirmation of bulk automation working reliably.
